# HydraForce Capacity Expansion

> Note: **HydraForce** (this project — a **capacity expansion** at the **Greenville** HPU plant)
> is distinct from **[HydraFlow](hydraflow-line-launch.md)** (a new **pump line launch** at
> **Rockford**). Similar names; do not conflate them.

- **Goal / definition of done:** stand up a **second HPU assembly cell** at **Greenville** to pull
  hydraulic-power-unit lead time from ~14 weeks back toward **8 weeks** and clear backlog.
- **Owner:** [Terrence Boyd](../people/terrence-boyd.md) — picked this up after
  [Karen Diaz](../people/karen-diaz.md) (former Greenville PM) departed.
- **Status:** on track, but exposed by the **vacant Greenville plant-manager seat**;
  [Sandra Kim](../people/sandra-kim.md) is covering the site until the backfill lands.
- **Capex note:** this is a leverage-moving capex item — flagged against the
  [First Meridian covenant](refinancing.md) before spend commits.

## Open items
- Fill the Greenville plant-manager role (see [commitments](../commitments.md)) — the expansion
  needs an owner on site.
